findings.title: idempotency check trusts an unverified producer-dir pk.json when no governor material exists
findings.disposition_rationale: In a governor-less directory audit verify resolves the same pk.json (the FAFF-978 published-PK fallback) and classifies the record identically, so the two readers agree; the fingerprint cross-check only exists when both files are present, where re-conclude now uses the governor key (99a73f36, test 7c). This is strictly stronger than main, which short-circuited on the kind name alone, and requiring the governor key would break the required replay of governor-less legacy ledgers (spec assertion 2). Surfaced in the PR body for FAFF-1177, which moves key custody out of the run directory.

findings.title: verifyAuthLeg reads the governor record twice, outside any lock
findings.disposition_rationale: efceff1b passes the governor record verifyAuthLeg already read into commissairePublicKey, so the key and the fingerprint check come from one read; Phase-1 delta review pass.
